name: Zhejiang Yonghe Refrigerant Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Yonghe Refrigerant Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in research and development, production, and sale of fluorinechemical products. It offers fluorocarbon chemicals; mixed refrigerants; fluorinated polymer materials and their monomers; fluorinated fine chemicals; fluorite concentrate; fluorite lump ore and chemical raw materials, such as hydrofluoric acid, chloromethane, methane chloride, and calcium chloride. The company also engages in transportation and trading businesses. Zhejiang Yonghe Refrigerant Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Quzhou, China.
